verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a fiat-to-crypto onramp that can be embedded on a website (Embedded onramp) or in a mobile app (Embedded components SDK), with a Stripe-hosted option as well. Stripe acts as merchant of record and handles KYC, fraud, and sanctions screening, and Bridge adds programmatic on-ramp APIs. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the onramp accepts card and bank-transfer funding, explicit confirmation that the purchasable assets include stablecoins (the docs say "cryptocurrencies"), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedded integration.
